description: Additive decomposition Y = trend + seasonal + residual. Use this to strip the seasonal cycle from a series and reveal the underlying trend | great for monthly or quarterly data (retail sales, unemployment). Returns per-timepoint components + summary amplitude. Runs on any verified autario indicator (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, ECB, US Census, SEC).

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

period.description: Seasonal period in time steps (12=monthly, 4=quarterly, 7=weekly). Auto-inferred from indicator frequency if omitted.

name: seasonality_decomposition
